content_patterns: Over-budget state communicated with red text + circled exclamation warning icon ('Over Rp 200.000') in place of the normal 'Remaining Rp …' pattern. Transactions in over-budget categories are also tinted red at the amount level (Indomaret '- Rp 120.000'), propagating status from category to related line items. Money formatted Indonesian-style with dot thousands separator and 'Rp' prefix. Uppercase micro-labels ('TOTAL EXPENSE', '14 SEP'). 'Remaining' stays green/positive for categories within budget.
notable_interactions: Same period navigation (chevrons), tappable transaction rows, and bottom nav with active 'Expenses' pill as default state. Red warning icon + red amounts imply alerting semantics rather than navigation. Progress bar unchanged in blue even when a category is over budget — per-category status is carried by text/icon color instead. Content cut off behind fixed bottom nav implies scrollable list.
